config.description: Mirror native controls from resolved logical targets and per-channel ownership. One unique effect name is displayed; mixed effects remain blank. Brightness uses logical level, colour constants (including Sara) use the resolved value. Sends only changed retained UI states, never device commands. Dry run skips discovery and returns messages.

force.description: Republish retained UI state after startup

config.description: Single queued writer. Source-keyed channel records merge per channel; no cross-scope deletion. Persistent power and range configuration are separate from expiring overrides.

Runs script.ls_apply: every minute (only fading lamps or lamps that just reached a block get commands), when a scheduled lamp switches on (it jumps straight to its current target; kitchen waits 1 s so its fixtures go out as one group command), when any lighting-schedule setting or the override store sensor.ls_overrides changes (applied instantly), and on HA start. Overrides are set by script.ls_override_block and the lamp change detector, and ended by the 'end overrides' rules. Per-lamp settings (input_text.ls_lamp_*) apply instantly through the ls_lamp_store_changed event that script.ls_store fires. A lamp returning from unavailable straight to on (wall power restored) also counts as switching on.

triggers.note: Power restored (wall switch back on): the lamp returns unavailable -> on at its own power-on setting, which light.turned_on does not report. Static list of house_schedule lamps; add new scheduled lamps here.
